title: 第二章  轮回之难，地球之殇
lines: 大乾王朝皇宫中，帝主的眉头紧皱着看着手中的奏折，眼神也是变得越来越深沉起来，因为这奏折上面写着:星辰帝国已经是在边境再投入了五十万的兵力用于战斗，目前已经有着几座城池已经是被星辰帝国给夺了回去，现在已经是紧闭大乾王朝城池，海宁城。
“好一个星辰帝国，看来真的是小瞧这这星辰帝国了，直接投入了五十万的兵力，这星辰帝国可真的破釜沉舟了吧，既然如此，那我大乾王朝又怎么能落后于这星辰帝国！”帝主喃喃着。
“来人！去吧廉颇给我叫来！现在是是时候让他带兵上战场了！”帝主对着阴影处人说了一声。
随着帝主声音的落下后，阴影处也是出现了一丝的空间波动。
时间已经是过去了两天，琼霄也要已经是恢复的差不多了，如今琼霄几人也是深处苍穹帝国皇宫之中，与苍穹帝国的帝主在商量着出兵的事宜。
“苍将军，如今大陆到底是什么情况？”深处龙椅上的帝主左手不停的敲打着龙椅，平静的问道。

“启禀帝主，现在的战事也可以说是不容乐观，星辰大陆已经是有着三个国家对星辰帝国发动了战争，而且投入的兵力也已经是达到了四百五之多，其中就处大乾王朝投入的兵力最多，已经是达到了两百万，而冰封王国以及新月国也是各自投入了一百万的兵力，但是想要以这四百万的兵力恐怕是难以抵挡这星辰帝国的进攻，据来自星辰帝国的探子传回来消息所知，星辰帝国如今又已经是向着三大帝国各自加派了五十万的兵力，现在总兵力已经是达到了五百五十万之多，而且这五百五十万的兵力也并不是最可靠的消息，因为这星辰帝国中还有着近千万的兵力没有派出！”
闻言，除了这苍穹帝国的帝主脸上没有任何的表情外，琼霄等人也是被这苍影的一席话给震惊了一下，千万的兵力，恐怕星辰大陆北域五大帝国加起来的总兵力可能才走千万之多吧？真可真的没想到这星辰帝国竟然有如此多的兵力。
“如今随着星辰帝国一百五五十万的再次投入，使得原本平衡的战事就这么的被打破了。原本三大帝国也都是打入了星辰帝国的境内，可是如今星辰帝国不仅是把属于自己的领土给夺了回来，而且星辰帝国近两百五十万的兵力已经是兵临大乾王朝的城池，海宁城。”
“不仅仅如此，也有着近两百万的兵力也已经是直逼冰封王国的城市，冰海城，还好这冰海城地势比较严峻再加上这冰海城气温比较寒冷，加之这星辰帝国也是远离本土作战，因此也是有些受不住这无尽的寒冷，也使得星辰帝国的军队的攻势收到了阻碍，要不然这海宁城可可能真的有些不保了。”
“不过，情况最为严峻的应该是新月国了，不仅是节节的败退，而且还丢了一座城池，不过这新月国也是不甘示弱，也是不断的增兵，再这么增兵下去，这新月国恐怕也要达到两百万之多！”

帝主缓缓的深吸了一口气，“没想到这星辰帝国的实力竟然已经是达到了如此恐怖的一面，朕原本以为这星辰帝国虽然可以说的上是这星辰大陆北域最为强大的帝国，不过也就相对于一个国家而已，一旦两个或者三个国家连手的话，应该是能够压制的住这星辰帝国的，可没想到真还是估计错了，照现在的形式来看的话。就算是五大帝国连手，恐怕也难以压制的住这星辰帝国，看来这星辰帝国的野心这么很大，要不是出了这么件事的话，恐怕朕还不知道这星辰帝国的真正实力呢？”
“那帝主打算怎么办？”琼霄也是紧皱着眉头，从这苍影的情报中，他也是知道了战事的严峻，不过他知道这苍穹帝国的帝主可不是什么胆小怕事的人，哪怕是星辰帝国实力在强大，他也相信这苍穹帝国的帝主也敢于亮剑。
“呵呵，怎么办，事到如今也没有什么办法了，既然他星辰帝国想要称霸大陆北域的话，那我们也就只能是奋力一搏了！”
“苍影，传令下去，让十大元帅理科出兵星辰帝国，他星辰帝国不是狠么，那朕也让他们看一看苍穹帝国的狠劲。”
content_zh:
“是你！琼霄，”望着这俊美的男生，魔龙回想起当年的巅峰对决，那一战奠定了琼霄的王者之路，那一站，他的主子黑暗宇宙之主连十招都接不下，说的好听是巅峰之战，说的不好听就是黑暗宇宙之主被纯虐的战斗！

    如今的的魔龙对当年的事情还心有余悸！不过如今站在他面前的琼霄只是只是一个凡人，他怎么可能会输，魔龙挣扎着。

    “琼霄，如今你已经是肉体凡胎，你还以为你还是以前那个霸气绝伦的琼霄吗？怪只怪当初你没有毁灭我们黑暗宇宙，现在的你，拿什么跟我们斗，你为了要追求武道的巅峰，妄想突破光明和黑暗的禁锢，居然放弃自身力量，进入轮回，哈哈，没想到我会在这你轮回的第九世灭杀你吧，琼霄，怪只怪你当初选错了道路，既然选错了道路那就准备受死吧，杀了你，我们黑暗宇宙就可以把光明宇宙纳入我黑暗宇宙的版图之下了，”

    “跟你主子一样自以为是，你以为如今的我就不能杀了你么，魔龙，就算我没有了力量，我一样可以杀了你！”说着王琼身体漂浮起来。“地球的万物生灵，请你们借我力量，保护这世间，拜托了，请赐我力量。”

    话音刚落，天空雷龙翻滚，闪电飞逝，无数元气形成的光柱注入王琼的体内，王琼的气势节节攀升！魔龙惊恐了，他万万没有想到，这平凡的位面给琼霄的力量居然那么大，如果是他全盛时期，到没什么可怕的，可不知道为什么他来地球后，力量反而受到压制，如今体内的力量不足全盛的十分之一。“事到如今，只能借住我主投影来杀了他”魔龙心道。

    “接招吧，魔龙，混沌秩序，毁天灭地！”琼霄低吼着。

    “想要我死，琼霄，你太天真了！黑暗投影，我主降临！”魔龙自爆一臂，血肉飞溅，形成了一道身影，身影一出，整个天地瞬间变的压抑起来，身影形成的气势，使得没有任何力量的地球人直接跪倒在地上，一些人甚至昏迷。

    “琼霄没想到会是这样子见面，来吧，琼霄！看看你所聚集的力量能否抵御我这投影的杀招，黑暗之手”！身影爆出的杀招，两股力量带着强悍的风暴相向而来，所到之处空间破碎，轰，一声巨响，两股力量交融在一起，能量风暴所肆虐的地方，全变的面目全非。“砰”那投影形成的黑暗之手瞬间破碎，巨大的能量朝魔龙一伙以及身影袭来，“轰，”正面击中，地面顿时出现了一个巨大的洞，深不见底。

    “没想到，没有了力量你依然那么强，今天杀不了你，也算你命不该绝，如今地球遭受破坏，我看看你拿什么拯救，琼霄，如今你的轮回受到影响，我看你拿什么跟我黑暗宇宙斗！哈哈”身影说道。

    “摩西，我琼霄现在指天发誓，待我轮回之劫结束，我必定杀入黑暗宇宙，必将亲手取你性命，就连你身后的人，也休想保你，”琼霄愤怒道。

    “你怎么知道我我师傅，不可能，你怎么可能感觉的到我师傅的存在！就算你知道我师傅又能怎样，难道你还想杀我师傅，当初我师傅要不是受伤，你真以为自己是我们黑暗宇宙的对手！等我师傅恢复，你又能如何？现在的你能不能拯救你所热爱的地球，还是个问题，你拿什么跟我斗，拿什么跟我斗，哈哈！地球遭受伤害，你没法解决，你就不可能完成轮回，现在杀不了你，他日，我必将亲自下界杀你！我绝不会让你完成轮回的！”话音一落，身影和魔龙一伙人消失而去。

    望着满目疮痍的世界，王琼落泪了。

    “想我琼霄短短数百年统一光明，为了给宇宙一个和平发展的局面，而放弃力量下界轮回，如今就剩两世，没想到，第八世出现了意外，我无颜回天界啊，”王琼痛苦着。

    “琼霄哥哥，都是我们不好，如果不是我们非要下界找你，他们都怎么可能知道你轮回的踪迹，你要骂就骂我们吧，是我们害了地球”。看着王琼痛苦的挣扎着王秀儿早已泪流满面。

    看着坑坑洼洼的地面，望着受伤的人，琼霄跪了下来，身后的六女也跪了下来，以前的琼霄曾经说过，男儿只跪父母，师父，绝不会再向别人下跪，如今的他跪了！

    “地球，我对不起你，我对不起大家，我不该在这里轮回！我琼霄发誓，我不恢复你从前的原貌，我绝不再轮回，是生是死，我都和你们在一起，说完，王琼即刻行了三拜九叩之礼。

    王琼看着六女：“我的傻女人们，我当初不让你们下来，就是怕你们受伤害，可你们还是下来了，云儿，莹儿，倩儿，秀儿，丽丹，雪儿，我对不起你们，让你们担心了。”
content_en:
"It's you! Qiong Xiao," looking at this handsome boy, Molong recalled the peak duel that year. That battle established Qiong Xiao's path to kingship. At that station, his master, the Lord of the Dark Universe, couldn't even take ten moves. To put it nicely, it was the pinnacle battle, but to put it badly, it was a battle in which the Lord of the Dark Universe was completely tortured!

Today's demon dragon still has lingering fears about what happened back then!But Qiong Xiao standing in front of him now is just a mortal, how could he lose, the dragon struggled.

"Qiong Xiao, now that you are mortal, do you still think you are still the domineering Qiong Xiao you used to be? No wonder you didn't destroy our dark universe back then. Now, what are you doing to fight us? In order to pursue the pinnacle of martial arts and to break through the shackles of light and darkness, you actually gave up.Use your own power to enter reincarnation, haha, I didn’t expect that I would kill you in this ninth life of your reincarnation, Qiong Xiao, it’s just that you chose the wrong path at the beginning. Since you chose the wrong path, prepare to die. If I kill you, our dark universe can incorporate the light universe into the territory of my dark universe,”

"As self-righteous as your master, do you think I can't kill you now, Demon Dragon, even if I have no power, I can still kill you!" Wang Qiong's body floated as he spoke."All creatures on earth, please lend me your power to protect this world. Please, please give me power."

As soon as he finished speaking, the thunder dragon rolled in the sky, lightning flew by, and countless light pillars formed by vitality were injected into Wang Qiong's body. Wang Qiong's momentum was rising steadily!The demon dragon was horrified. He never thought that this ordinary plane would give Qiong Xiao so much power. If it was in his prime, there would be nothing to fear. But for some reason, after he came to Earth, his power was suppressed. Now the power in his body is less than one-tenth of his peak power."Now that things have come to a point, we can only use my master's projection to kill him," the demon dragon thought in his heart.

"Take the move, Demonic Dragon, Chaos Order, Destruction of Heaven and Earth!" Qiong Xiao roared.

"You want me to die, Qiong Xiao, you are so naive! Dark projection, my lord has arrived!" The demonic dragon exploded one arm, and blood and flesh spattered, forming a figure. As soon as the figure appeared, the whole world became depressed in an instant. The momentum formed by the figure caused the people on earth who had no power to kneel directly to the ground, and some people even fell into coma.

"Qiong Xiao didn't expect to meet like this. Come on, Qiong Xiao! See if the power you have gathered can withstand my projected killer move, the hand of darkness"!The silhouette exploded with a killing move, and the two forces came towards each other with a powerful storm. The space was shattered wherever they went, and with a loud bang, the two forces merged together. The place where the energy storm was raging was completely changed beyond recognition."Bang" The hand of darkness formed by the projection shattered instantly, and huge energy attacked the demon dragon group and the figure. "Boom," hit it head-on, and a huge hole suddenly appeared on the ground, which was bottomless.

"I didn't expect that you are still so strong without your power. If I can't kill you today, it means that your life should not be cut off. Now that the earth is being destroyed, let's see what you can do to save it. Qiong Xiao, now your reincarnation has been affected. Let's see what you can do to fight against my dark universe! Haha" the figure said.

"Moses, I, Qiong Xiao, swear to the sky now that when my reincarnation is over, I will definitely enter the dark universe and take your life with my own hands. Even the people behind you will not even think of protecting you," Qiong Xiao said angrily.

"How do you know my master? Impossible, how can you feel the existence of my master! Even if you know my master, what can you do? Do you still want to kill my master? If my master was not injured at the beginning, you really thought you were our opponent in the dark universe! What can you do when my master recovers? Can you save you now?The beloved earth is still a problem, what do you use to fight against me, haha!If the earth is hurt and you can't solve it, you can't complete the reincarnation.I can't kill you now, and I will definitely kill you in the future!" As soon as he finished speaking, the figure and the demon dragon disappeared.

Looking at the devastated world, Wang Qiong shed tears.

"I thought that I, Qiongxiao, had unified the light in just a few hundred years, and gave up my power to reincarnate in the lower world in order to create a peaceful development situation for the universe. Now I only have two lives left. Unexpectedly, an accident occurred in my eighth life, and I have no face to return to the heaven," Wang Qiong said in pain.

"Brother Qiong Xiao, it's all our fault. If we hadn't insisted on finding you in the lower world, how could they have known about your reincarnation? If you want to scold us, just scold us. It's us who have harmed the earth."Seeing Wang Qiong struggling in pain, Wang Xiuer had already burst into tears.

Looking at the bumpy ground and the injured people, Qiong Xiao knelt down, and the six women behind him also knelt down. Qiong Xiao once said in the past that a man would only kneel to his parents and master, and would never kneel to others again. Now he knelt!

"Earth, I'm sorry for you, I'm sorry for everyone, I shouldn't be reincarnated here! I, Qiongxiao, swear that I will not restore your original appearance, and I will never reincarnate again. Whether in life or in death, I will be with you. After saying this, Wang Qiong immediately performed three bows and nine kowtows.

Wang Qiong looked at the six girls: "My silly women, I didn't let you come down at first because I was afraid that you would be hurt, but you came down anyway, Yun'er, Ying'er, Qian'er, Xiu'er, Lidan, Xue'er, I'm sorry for making you worry."
